direction_system.angle_convention: canvas radians, x right, y DOWN (direction8.ts DEG table)
direction_system.diagonal_model: Option B: diagonal = two ADJACENT cardinals held together; second key must land within 0.09s of the first; both held through the judging frame
direction_system.judgement_receptor: point on the judgement ring at the direction's angle: centre + DIRECTION_VECTOR * RING_RADIUS
direction_system.renderer: cardinal notes = discs r=0.027; diagonal notes = squares half-side 0.024; per-direction colour; note visuals drawn entirely by RadialMode (mechanic render() is empty)
direction_system.direction_parse_fallback: invalid entries silently dropped; D01/D02 all-invalid falls back to ['N']; D06 all-invalid falls back to full 8-step clockwise
dead_helpers: direction8.CARDINALS / DIAGONALS consts (never imported; RadialMode keeps its own CARDINAL_LIST)

input.cardinal_refusal_rule: a cardinal target refuses its key while an ADJACENT cardinal is down with press-time difference <= 0.09s (the press reads as a diagonal); opposite cardinals are exempt and fire independently
input.edge_detection: per-frame pressedThisFrame; OS key-repeat filtered; endFrame() clears each frame
input.input_buffer: none (presses before -0.25 beat do nothing and are not cached)
input.opposite_keys: independent, both fire (opposite double = two hits)
input.adjacent_keys_within_tolerance: interpreted as diagonal; both cardinal judgements refused
input.adjacent_keys_beyond_tolerance: independent; a stale (>0.09s) key neither blocks a cardinal nor completes a diagonal
input.press_consumption: non-consuming: one press edge can satisfy multiple pending targets in the same frame snapshot (duplicate same-direction notes double-score; NE+SE can share one E press)
input.simultaneous_cap_runtime: none; physical limit is 4 cardinal keys
input.max_scoreable_targets_note: 4 keys pressed together hit at most the 4 DIAGONAL targets; the 4 cardinal targets are refused by the aliasing rule, so an 8-target same-beat chord can never be fully cleared
input.chord_aliasing: N+E+S+W pressed together (<=0.09s) reads as NE+SE+SW+NW, never as four cardinal hits
input.blur_behaviour: all key state cleared on window blur
input.frame_snapshot: cardinal edges sampled once per frame before judging; all chord targets see the same snapshot (RadialMode.update)

judgement.unit: beats (BPM-scaled); windows from TUNING.radial, shared NoteMode judge path
judgement.early_late: symmetric on abs(offset); presses before -0.25 beat ignored without penalty; no per-ms early/late split
judgement.direction_mismatch: no immediate penalty; wrong-direction press simply fails justPressed; note resolves as MISS when the window passes
judgement.simultaneous_directions: each target judged independently against the same per-frame input snapshot; no exclusivity
judgement.hold_release: NOT SUPPORTED (no radial mechanic emits holdBeats > 0; BROKEN state unreachable in RADIAL)
judgement.score_system: none (no point score); accuracy = notesHit/(notesHit+notesMissed); verdictCounts tracked but not rendered by RadialMode
judgement.death: health 0 -> outcome FAILED -> judging stops; onDeath clears schedule and hazards

geometry.travel: straight line inward along the direction vector; radius linear in beats: RING + (beatsAway/approachBeats)*(SPAWN-RING)
geometry.travel_easing: none (linear); easeOutCubic only on the hit ripple
geometry.miss_trail: missed notes keep converging past the ring to expire at radius 0.012 (~0.715 beats after target); mechanic detaches at +0.6 beats which truncates the fade (cosmetic)
geometry.d06_first_note_note: D06 spawn lead (library telegraph 1 beat) < approach 2 beats: its first note appears mid-arm at radius ~0.295 instead of at the rim

notes.name: Single

direction.accepted: 8 direction names + legacy aliases (UP/NORTH, RIGHT/EAST, DOWN/SOUTH, LEFT/WEST, UP_RIGHT/NORTH_EAST, DOWN_RIGHT/SOUTH_EAST, DOWN_LEFT/SOUTH_WEST, UP_LEFT/NORTH_WEST), case-insensitive
direction.clamp: invalid values silently dropped; all-invalid falls back to 'N'

notes.collision: none - dangerShapes() returns []; notes never damage on contact; the only damage source is MISS (-8 HP, bypasses invulnerability)

safe_to_autogenerate.constraints: any of the 8 directions; keep >= 0.5 beat between notes; do not place an adjacent-cardinal pair on the same beat

notes.name: Opposite Double (legacy name: accepts ANY direction chord)
notes.registry_key: D02 -> DirectionNoteMechanic (src/mechanics/radial/index.ts:10, same class as D01)

directions.accepted: any list of the 8 names + legacy aliases
directions.clamp: Set-dedup within the event (duplicates collapse to one target); invalid entries dropped; all-invalid falls back to ['N']

notes.collision: none - dangerShapes() returns []; only MISS damages health (-8 HP)

judgement.per_target: each direction judged independently; opposite pairs = two independent hits; same-beat adjacent cardinals cannot both score (diagonal aliasing)

timing.activation: all targets share the event's activationBeat

safe_to_autogenerate.constraints: recommended chord size <= 2; safe pairs = opposite cardinals (N+S, E+W) or diagonal opposites (NE+SW, NW+SE, requires a 4-key chord); NEVER place adjacent cardinals (N+E, E+S, S+W, W+N) on the same beat

notes.name: Clockwise (legacy name: sequence is fully data-driven, any order)

sequence.accepted: ordered list of the 8 names + legacy aliases; repeats allowed (no dedup)
sequence.clamp: invalid entries dropped; empty/all-invalid falls back to full 8-step clockwise [...DIRECTION8]

stepBeats.accepted: any finite number > 0, fractional allowed (library uses 0.5)
stepBeats.clamp: non-numeric or <= 0 falls back to 1; no upper bound; sequence may extend past the pattern's lengthBars

notes.collision: none - dangerShapes() returns []; only MISS damages health (-8 HP)

judgement.per_note: each NoteTarget carries its own beat = activationBeat + i * stepBeats; judged independently

timing.activation: first target at the event's activationBeat; target i at activationBeat + i*stepBeats
timing.first_note_warning: spawn lead (1) < approach (2): the first note pops in mid-arm instead of entering at the rim

safe_to_autogenerate.constraints: any ordering (CW/CCW/star/spiral are data); stepBeats >= 0.5 recommended (library densest); avoid stepBeats < 0.25 (windows overlap, one press double-scores)

not_supported.hold_notes: NOT SUPPORTED: both radial mechanics hardcode holdBeats: 0; the shared NoteMode hold machinery (judgeHold) and RadialMode.isHeld are runtime-present but unreachable from RADIAL JSON
not_supported.drift_or_path: NOT SUPPORTED: path/lane checkpoints are VERTICAL-only semantics
not_supported.outward_or_center_notes: NOT SUPPORTED: travel direction is hardcoded inward
not_supported.approach_speed_or_window_scaling: NOT SUPPORTED: approachBeats, hit windows and diagonal tolerance are fixed TUNING.radial constants with no JSON or difficulty consumers
not_supported.randomization: NOT SUPPORTED: radial mechanics do not consume the deterministic seed
not_supported.dedicated_double_tap_or_call_response: NOT SUPPORTED as mechanics; expressible only as data arrangements

sequencing.timing_resolution: arbitrary fractional beats: at.bar / at.beat (1-based) + offsetBeats + fractional stepBeats; no quantization
sequencing.pattern_placement: repeat (>=1) at startBar, laid end to end; placement intensity 0..1 default 0.5 (out-of-range is a load error)
sequencing.mode_transition: breather truncates events with activationBeat >= breatherFromBeat; pending-spawn buffer capped at 64 per mode (oldest dropped)
unsupported_semantics: dedicated ping-pong pattern (expressible manually via D06 sequence)

difficulty.section_difficulty_1_5: metadata-only for RADIAL gameplay: picks a readability tier that radial mechanics never read; real effects are ambient energy (sectionEnergy) and the section lead-in cap
difficulty.placement_intensity: metadata-only for RADIAL gameplay: feeds telegraph scaling whose result radial mechanics ignore; spawn lead uses the RAW library telegraph (unscaled); real effect is ambient energy only
difficulty.approach_windows_tolerance: fixed constants in TUNING.radial (approachBeats 2, windows 0.09/0.16/0.25, diagonalToleranceSeconds 0.09); no scaling consumers
difficulty.true_difficulty_source: pattern design only (direction mix, step length, density, chords)

safety.duplicate_direction_check: within one mechanic event only (Set dedupe); across events/mechanics duplicates are legal and one press scores all
safety.chord_cap: no runtime cap (distinct directions capped at 8 by dedupe; single-instant scoreable targets capped at 4 by the 4-key physical model and diagonal aliasing)
safety.feasibility_tools: none for RADIAL (fairness-check is ARENA-only; runner-check is RUNNER-only; sync-test verifies scheduling activation times headlessly, not playability; level-report has no radial checks)
safety.fairness_system_scope: src/core/fairness.ts is consumed exclusively by ARENA mechanics; the RADIAL mode has no fairness floor
safety.guarantee_statement: No runtime radial-chart feasibility guarantee detected.

music_affinity.kick_bass: D02 opposite chords (library musicTags KICK/BASS - metadata; DP06/DP11 instances)
music_affinity.melody_rising_falling: D06 compass-ordered sequences (DP04 CW / DP05 CCW); contour comes from direction ORDER only - note travel is always straight inward
music_affinity.arpeggio: D06 rotational/skip sequences (DP09 spiral, DP10 star)
music_affinity.phrase_boundary: D02 chord burst (library max 2 directions; runtime accepts more but human scoreability caps at what the 4-key model allows)

safe_generation_bounds.min_same_direction_interval_note: no runtime guard; library-densest = 0.5 beats (DP09/DP11); intervals < 0.25 beats overlap judgement windows and double-score from one press
safe_generation_bounds.max_runtime_chord_size_note: targets per beat uncapped in code; one D02 event dedupes to <= 8 distinct directions; a single instant can score at most 4 targets (the diagonals)
safe_generation_bounds.approach_time: 2 beats (fixed; TUNING.radial.approachBeats); D06 first note effectively 1 beat
safe_generation_bounds.min_direction_change_interval_note: no runtime guard; same-beat adjacent-cardinal pairs are effectively unplayable (diagonal aliasing); diagonal two-key window is 0.09s real time
safe_generation_bounds.authoring_resolution: arbitrary fractional beat + offsetBeats + fractional stepBeats

known_risks: Adjacent cardinals pressed within 0.09s alias to a diagonal: a same-beat adjacent-cardinal chord can never score as two cardinal hits (both eventually MISS, -8 HP each)
N+E+S+W pressed together reads as the four DIAGONALS only; an 8-target same-beat chord can never be fully cleared (single-instant maximum is 4 scored targets)
Non-consuming presses: duplicate same-direction notes on one beat all score from one press (no validator forbids this)
D06 spawn lead (1 beat) is shorter than the approach (2 beats): its first note pops in mid-arm
MISSED note fade is truncated when the mechanic detaches (activation+0.6) before the expiry radius is reached (~+0.715 beats) - cosmetic
difficulty/intensity and pattern constraints (maxSimultaneousThreats, requiresMechanics, minReactionBeats) have no gameplay effect in RADIAL
No holds despite shared NoteMode support; hold tolerances live under TUNING.vertical
diagonalToleranceSeconds (0.09s) is real time, independent of BPM, so diagonal difficulty varies with tempo
No runtime feasibility/overlap guard: chart safety is entirely the author's responsibility
Invalid direction strings never error at load; they silently become 'N' (D01/D02) or the default 8-step sequence (D06)
unknown_or_needs_runtime_verification: Playtest-feasible minimum intervals (0.09s diagonal tolerance feel; <0.25-beat same-direction streams) - analysis-derived, not machine-verified
